queries.gold_sql: SELECT job_category, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs_scoped GROUP BY job_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY job_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS sample_size, median(salary_mid_monthly) AS median_monthly_salary FROM jobs_scoped WHERE city IN ('北京','上海','深圳') AND salary_parse_status = 'success' AND salary_mid_monthly IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY city

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS sample_size, median(salary_mid_monthly) AS median_monthly_salary FROM jobs_scoped WHERE job_category = 'data' AND salary_parse_status = 'success' AND salary_mid_monthly IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY median_monthly_salary DESC, city LIMIT 20

SELECT education, COUNT(*) AS sample_size, median(salary_mid_monthly) AS median_monthly_salary, AVG(salary_mid_monthly) AS avg_monthly_salary FROM jobs_scoped WHERE salary_parse_status = 'success' AND salary_mid_monthly IS NOT NULL GROUP BY education HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY median_monthly_salary DESC

SELECT job_category, SUM(CASE WHEN instr(skills, '"operations"') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operations_frequency, SUM(CASE WHEN instr(skills, '"sql"') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sql_frequency, SUM(CASE WHEN instr(skills, '"product_management"') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_management_frequency, SUM(CASE WHEN instr(skills, '"excel"') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excel_frequency, SUM(CASE WHEN instr(skills, '"python"') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS python_frequency, COUNT(*) AS sample_size FROM jobs_scoped WHERE job_category IN ('product','operations','data') GROUP BY job_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY job_category

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS job_count, SUM(CASE WHEN salary_parse_status = 'success' AND salary_mid_monthly IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS salary_available_count FROM jobs_scoped GROUP BY source HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY source

SELECT company_size, COUNT(*) AS sample_size, median(salary_mid_monthly) AS median_monthly_salary, AVG(salary_mid_monthly) AS avg_monthly_salary FROM jobs_scoped WHERE salary_parse_status = 'success' AND salary_mid_monthly IS NOT NULL GROUP BY company_size HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY median_monthly_salary DESC

SELECT source, job_category, COUNT(*) AS sample_size, AVG(CASE WHEN description_available = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS missing_description_rate FROM jobs_scoped GROUP BY source, job_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY missing_description_rate DESC, sample_size DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT title, company, city, job_category FROM jobs_scoped WHERE city = '上海' AND job_category IN ('data','business_analysis') ORDER BY company, title LIMIT 200
SELECT title, company, city, job_category FROM jobs_scoped WHERE city = '北京' AND (lower(title) LIKE '%ai%' OR job_category = 'product') ORDER BY company, title LIMIT 200
SELECT company, city, source, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs_scoped GROUP BY company, city, source ORDER BY job_count DESC, company LIMIT 200
SELECT title, company, city, job_category FROM jobs_scoped WHERE city = '深圳' AND (job_category = 'product' OR title LIKE '%风险%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%risk%') ORDER BY company, title LIMIT 200

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs_scoped WHERE job_category = 'product' GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY job_count DESC, city LIMIT 20
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs_scoped WHERE job_category = 'product' GROUP BY city ORDER BY job_count DESC, city LIMIT 20
